meta.notes: Plan calibrated to actual fitness: 53km/week trailing average, 71.5km peak week Jul 20, 28km long run at 5:10/km HR 148, 10km at goal pace HR 160. Limiter is not speed — it's sustaining MP deep into the long run. Plan prioritises MP-specific work from Week 8, embedded in long runs rather than added on top.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.focus: Establish rhythm. Matches your current baseline — no artificial ramp. Wednesday tempo is the only quality session.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.detail: 10 km @ 5:20–5:40/km. HR cap 145. Genuinely conversational — if you can't hold a sentence, slow down.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym only. No running.

sessions.name: Threshold — 5 km continuous
sessions.detail: 3 km WU @ easy · 5 km @ 4:12–4:18/km (threshold, not all-out) · 2 km CD. Total 10 km. This is your hardest session this week — treat it as such.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ 5:20–5:40/km. 6×20 s strides after at controlled sprint pace — full recovery between each.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off running. Strength if scheduled.

sessions.name: Long run — 27 km easy
sessions.detail: All @ 5:30/km. No pace work this week. Practice gel protocol: 1 gel every 40 min starting at 40 min. This should feel controlled throughout — if HR climbs above 152 after km 20, slow down.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full recovery. Optional 20-min walk only.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.focus: Volume steady, long run slightly shorter to let Wednesday's interval session be the quality anchor. First taste of faster work.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym only.

sessions.name: Intervals — 4×1600 m
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 4×1600 m @ 4:00/km with 90 s jog recovery · 2 km CD. Total 12 km. Rep 1 should feel controlled — you'll know if you go out too fast by rep 3.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ easy. 6×20 s strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 24 km, last 5 km @ MP
sessions.detail: 19 km @ 5:30/km · then 5 km @ 4:30/km (MP). First MP work of the block. The goal is not to feel the 5 km — it's to learn what 4:30 feels like on tired legs.

sessions.name: Recovery run
sessions.detail: 4 km @ 5:45/km or rest. Listen to your body.

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.focus: New long run high — but only 1 km past what you ran pre-block. Safe extension. Tempo gets harder.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Tempo — 2×4 km
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 2×4 km @ 4:12–4:15/km with 3 min float recovery · 2 km CD. Total 13 km. The float should be 5:00/km — not a walk, not a jog, a controlled float.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.detail: 10 km @ easy. No strides — legs need to be fresh for Saturday.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 29 km, last 8 km @ MP
sessions.detail: 21 km @ 5:30/km · then 8 km @ 4:30/km. This is the first meaningful MP block in a long run. If you can run the last 8 km at 4:30 and still hold form, sub-3:10 is credible.

sessions.name: Recovery run
sessions.detail: 5 km @ 5:45+/km. Very easy.

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.focus: Real cutback. Do not add volume because you feel good. This week is where adaptation from weeks 1–3 happens.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.detail: 10 km @ 5:30/km. Slower than normal — this is a recovery week.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Intervals — 5×1 km
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 5×1 km @ 3:58/km with 2 min jog · 2 km CD. Total 11 km. Short and sharp — high quality, low volume.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ easy. 6×20 s strides.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 19 km easy
sessions.detail: All @ 5:30–5:40/km. No pace work. Pure aerobic recovery run.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off. No running.

weeks.label: Week 5
weeks.focus: Back into build. Volume moderated vs. original plan — 30% jump off cutback is the real constraint. Continuous tempo this week.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Tempo — 6 km continuous
sessions.detail: 3 km WU · 6 km @ 4:12/km · 3 km CD. Total 12 km. The longest continuous tempo of the block so far.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 10 km @ easy. Strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 26 km, 3×5 km @ MP
sessions.detail: 3 km easy · 5 km @ 4:30 · 2 km float · 5 km @ 4:30 · 2 km float · 5 km @ 4:30 · 4 km easy. Total 26 km. Three MP blocks with floats — this is the session that builds confidence in repeating goal pace.

weeks.label: Week 6
weeks.focus: Tune-up half marathon Sunday 20 Sep. Target 1:29–1:32. This is the block's fitness test — under 1:32 confirms sub-3:10, over 1:35 means we recalibrate.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.detail: 10 km @ 5:30/km. Race week starts here — keep it easy.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Sharpener — 4×1 km
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 4×1 km @ 3:55/km with 2 min jog · 2 km CD. Total 10 km. Sharp and fast — this primes the legs for Sunday, it doesn't tire them.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ easy. 6×20 s strides.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off. Legs up.

sessions.name: Shakeout — 5 km + strides
sessions.detail: 5 km very easy + 4×20 s strides. Race kit, race shoes. Get the legs turning over.

sessions.name: HALF MARATHON — race it
sessions.detail: Target 1:29–1:32 (4:15–4:22/km). Full race-day rehearsal: same gels, same kit, same breakfast, same warm-up. Do not go out at 4:10 — start at 4:20 and build. The second half should be faster than the first.

weeks.label: Week 7
weeks.focus: Genuine recovery post-race. Half marathon damage is real even when it doesn't feel like it. No quality until Saturday.

sessions.name: Recovery or rest
sessions.detail: 5 km very easy or full rest. Your choice based on how Sunday felt.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ easy. Strides only if legs feel good.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 18 km easy
sessions.detail: All @ 5:30–5:40/km. Rebuild the aerobic base. No pace work. If legs still feel heavy from the half, slow down further.

weeks.label: Week 8
weeks.focus: Peak block begins. MP segments embedded in long run from here — targeting the specific gap: sustaining goal pace deep into a run. Weeks 8–10 are load-bearing, protect them.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Tempo — 3×3 km
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 3×3 km @ 4:10/km with 2 min jog · 3 km CD. Total 14 km.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 10 km @ easy. Strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 27 km, last 6 km @ MP
sessions.detail: 21 km @ 5:30/km · last 6 km @ 4:30/km. This is where the real work starts. The MP segment comes after 21 km of running — your legs should be honest by then. Full gel protocol.

weeks.label: Week 9
weeks.focus: Peak week — 76 km. Justified by your 71.5 km week in July. Last 10 km of the long run at MP. This is the session that decides the race.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym.

sessions.name: Tempo — 8 km continuous
sessions.detail: 3 km WU · 8 km @ 4:15/km · 4 km CD. Total 15 km. Longest continuous tempo of the block.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 10 km @ easy. Strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off. Sleep is training this week.

sessions.name: Long run — 32 km, last 10 km @ MP 🔑
sessions.detail: 22 km @ 5:30/km · last 10 km @ 4:30/km. The key session of the entire block. If you can run 10 km at 4:30 after 22 km on your legs, sub-3:10 is not a stretch — it's a plan. Full race kit, full gel protocol.

sessions.name: Recovery run
sessions.detail: 6 km @ 5:45+/km. Expect to feel this one.

weeks.label: Week 10
weeks.focus: Taper starts. Volume drops 3.5 weeks out. MP segment moves to mid-run — tests pace control, not just fatigue resistance. Dress rehearsal for everything.

sessions.name: Rest or strength
sessions.detail: Full rest or gym. Last week for strength.

sessions.name: Intervals — 5×1200 m
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 5×1200 m @ 3:58/km with 2 min jog · 2 km CD. Total 13 km.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 10 km @ easy. Strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Long run — 24 km, 8 km @ MP mid-run 👟
sessions.detail: 8 km easy · 8 km @ 4:30/km · 8 km easy. MP in the middle — not at the end. This tests whether you can lock into goal pace from a controlled start and then ease off. Race shoes. Race gels. Race breakfast. Nothing new after this.

weeks.label: Week 11
weeks.focus: Taper proper. Volume down ~26% from Week 10. You will feel sluggish and doubt everything. That is the taper working. Trust it.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full rest. No gym from here.

sessions.name: Sharpener tempo — 3×2 km
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 3×2 km @ 4:12/km with 90 s jog · 2 km CD. Total 11 km. Sharp, not exhausting. The purpose is neuromuscular, not fitness.

sessions.name: Easy + strides
sessions.detail: 8 km @ easy. Strides after.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full day off.

sessions.name: Last long run — 16 km, 4 km @ MP
sessions.detail: 12 km easy · 4 km @ 4:30. Last MP work before race day. Should feel easy. If it doesn't, the taper isn't done yet — slow the rest of the week down.

sessions.name: Recovery run
sessions.detail: 5 km very easy.

weeks.label: Week 12
weeks.focus: Race week. Do less than you want to. Carb-load Thu–Sat (8g/kg/day). Travel to NYC Friday. Expo Saturday morning, off your feet by noon.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.detail: 8 km @ 5:30/km. Relaxed. Last real training run.

sessions.name: Rest
sessions.detail: Full rest.

sessions.name: MP touch — 4×800 m
sessions.detail: 2 km WU · 4×800 m @ 4:30/km · 2 km CD. Total 6 km. Pace memory only — you're not building fitness, you're reminding your legs what 4:30 feels like.

sessions.name: Easy 4 km
sessions.detail: 4 km very easy. Begin carb-loading: rice, pasta, bread, fruit. 8g carb/kg bodyweight.

sessions.name: Travel to NYC
sessions.detail: Fly to NYC. Legs up on the plane. Hydrate. No walking tours.

sessions.name: Shakeout 3 km + strides
sessions.detail: 3 km easy + 4×20 s strides. Expo in the morning, done by noon. Lay out kit: Alphafly 3, race bib, gels (GU non-caff early, Roctane caff back half, Maurten CAF 100 late), watch charged. Early night.

sessions.name: TCS NYC MARATHON — Sub 3:10
sessions.detail: Start: Staten Island, 9:50 AM corral. Go out at 4:33/km for the first 10 km. Hold 4:30 to Queensboro Bridge (km 24) — do not chase time on the bridges, chase effort. Fifth Ave from km 37 is the race. Maurten CAF 100 at km 35. Cross Central Park finish at sub 3:10.
